recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open model weights spreading through developer forums
homelab racks getting torn down and rebuilt overnight
inference budgets swallowing entire corporate floors
wildfire smoke drifting across Mediterranean coastlines
clear sixteen-degree morning over the bay
summer sunset stretching past eight twenty-five

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling weight files before they hit the ground — each shard you grab unlocks a tiny model that runs a one-line prediction. Miss three and the stack collapses.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to move a catch basket left-right
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each caught weight triggers a satisfying micro-inference flash; stacking five in a row feels like a combo unlock
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fall speed increases and shards split into smaller fragments that scatter unpredictably
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green on black, monospace particles

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Reboot a crashed homelab by tapping server nodes in the correct boot sequence — fans spin up, lights flicker, rack hums back to life before the UPS dies.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each successful boot adds a glowing service icon; full rack online in under a minute feels like resurrection
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: sequence length grows and decoy nodes blink to throw you off rhythm
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: dim server-room blue LEDs and cable spaghetti

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw evacuation paths through a burning hillside map — your finger traces safe corridors for tiny figures while wind shifts the fire front each second.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch a route, release to commit
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: every figure you shepherd to the coast adds to a rescue tally; one clean path saves a cluster at once
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fire spreads faster, paths already drawn start smoldering and must be redrawn

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick smoke plumes off a coastal cliff before they blanket the bay — each puff carries a different density and drifts on changing wind vectors.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing a whole gust in one swipe sends a brief glimpse of blue sky — visual payoff in seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind direction rotates every ten seconds; dense plumes require two flicks to disperse
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: misty SF bay panorama, soft grey gradients
